messages:

Subject: New vendor onboarding — tax paperwork and legal name

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — excited to get Redwood live for our in-app search experiments. Procurement asked me to send the documents you need to open the PO. Two quick items they flagged:

- Which tax form do you need from a Canadian-registered entity? (W-9 vs W-8BEN-E)
- Our legal registrant name is "Helium Works Ltd." but we trade as "Helium" — which name should appear on the W-8?

I attached our company profile and an unsigned W-8BEN-E template to speed things up. Let me know exactly what to return and any signatory requirements.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Finance, Helium Works
Attachment: company_profile_heliumworks.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: w8bene_template.pdf (pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@heliumworks.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — tax paperwork and legal name

Elena —

Appreciate the fast follow-up. For Redwood to issue a US-based PO to a non-US vendor we need either:

- A completed W-8BEN-E with the legal registrant name matching your government registration and your foreign TIN filled in, OR
- For US entities a W-9 with EIN.

From your note it sounds like Helium Works Ltd. is a Canadian entity, so please complete a W-8BEN-E. Important details for our finance team:

1) Line 1 (Name of organization): must be your legal registrant name exactly as on the Articles of Incorporation (e.g., "Helium Works Ltd."). Do not use the trading name.
2) Provide your Canadian Business Number or equivalent in the foreign TIN field.
3) Signature: we accept a scanned signature from an authorized officer. If the signatory isn't listed on your corporate registry, please include a signer authorization letter.
4) Bank reference: procurement sometimes asks for a bank letter or voided check to confirm remittance instructions — please attach if available.

Cc'ing Kimberly (payments) and Monica (procurement) to help validate once you return the docs. If you prefer, we can send a DocuSign envelope to the authorized signee.

Next step: send the completed W-8BEN-E + bank letter and we'll queue the PO. Our target SLA for PO creation after validated docs is 3 business days.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Rishi,

Thanks — we completed the W-8BEN-E and attached it. Small hiccup: our Articles list the entity as "Helium Works Canada ULC" for legal purposes, while our W-8 template prefilled "Helium Works Ltd." (legacy). Can you confirm which exact string will be accepted? Attached: signed_w8bene_draft.pdf and a bank letter.

If the exact registrant name needs to match the Articles, we can request a signed certificate from our registrar, but that may take a couple of days.

Attachments: signed_w8bene_draft.pdf (pdf); bank_letter.pdf (pdf)

Regards,
Elena

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@heliumworks.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — tax paperwork and legal name

Elena —

Thanks for sending the signed packet. Quick internal note: our payments team requires the legal registrant name to match a government file to prevent ACH remittance mismatches and IRS reporting issues. "Helium Works Canada ULC" versus "Helium Works Ltd." is material. We can accept the W-8BEN-E once either:

- You supply a one-page official registry extract or certificate (PDF) showing the legal name, OR
- Provide a notarized signer authorization that ties the person who signed the W-8 to the legal entity name you use commercially.

If you can send the registry extract, we can proceed immediately and issue the PO within our SLA window. If not, please confirm and we'll switch to a DocuSign path with an additional signer verification step (adds 48 hours).

Once we have the registry extract or notarized authorization and the bank letter you already attached, I'll route to AP and we will create PO PR-4527.

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Payments & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample_registry_extract_instructions.txt (txt)
